title: melandrium indicum
intro: Melandrium indicum, commonly known as Rock Jasmine or Himalayan Pansy, is a flowering plant native to the Himalayan region. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce fever and treat wounds. The therapeutic actions of Melandrium indicum include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used to treat various health conditions.
